profile.headline: SWE @Meta
profile.summary: Hi! My name is Jenny Lee and I am a senior studying Computer Science and Computer Engineering at USC. I am passionate about exploring the intersection between software engineering and education.

positions.title: President
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Worked in the PORT Analytics team under Financial Analytics and created Bobcat 2.0, a flexible and intuitive testing platform to run A-B regression testing on native Bloomberg Python services.
- Implemented a database logging system as well as asynchronous refresh of the front end to ensure real time testing results.
- Implemented a templating system to allow engineers to create and share inputs to Bobcat 2.0 quickly and easily.

positions.title: Director of Technical Resources
positions.description:
- Lead and coordinate the project for the mini hackathons 
- Create and teach technical tutorials to the Makers community as well as to other interested audiences

positions.title: Director of Outreach
positions.description:
- Worked with different companies and brought recruiting events to students on campus
- Led the community outreach initiative and presented our projects at local STEM fairs
- Maintained alumni relationships
- Organized career panels

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant, Interaction Lab
positions.description: Worked in a team of undergraduate and PhD students to study ways to promote kinesthetic curiosity in education with robots and MR platforms.

positions.title: USC Viterbi Course Producer
positions.description:
Course Producer for EE109 (Introduction to Embedded Systems)
- Held office hours to assist with homework and labs
- Helped run lab sections
- Graded and proctored exams

positions.title: Explorer Intern
positions.description:
- Problem: There is a lack of transparency between the different teams in Office and the build costs that they incur
- Solution: Design and build a custom dashboard that implements sorting and filtering features illustrating the breakdown of build costs each Microsoft Office team incurs
- Technologies and Frameworks used: Typescript, React, SCSS, C#, Cosmos DB, Kusto DB, Azure Functions
